project_type: Flutter app (BrainBuddies): comic-styled hub of 6 educational mini-games for kids grades 1-3. Hub/core shared code + self-contained per-game folders.
build_system: Flutter. On this Windows machine flutter is at %USERPROFILE%\flutter; always call it explicitly as & "$env:USERPROFILE\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" <cmd>. Shell is PowerShell: use ';' not '&&', and $env:VAR not %VAR%. The worktree path contains non-ASCII (Hebrew) characters.
test_framework: flutter_test (package:flutter_test) + shared_preferences mock via SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({}). Tests live in test/. Currently 10 tests pass across test/widget_test.dart, test/money_make_change_test.dart, test/word_wizard_speaker_test.dart, test/analytics_test.dart.
verification_instructions: 1) Build: run build web; SUCCESS = the line 'Built build\web' is present in output. A trailing 'Exit Code: 1' from a Select-String filter with no match after the Built line is NOT a build failure. 2) Test: run flutter test; all tests must pass. 3) NEVER run 'flutter analyze' — it CRASHES because the project path contains non-ASCII (Hebrew) characters (analysis server URI parser fails). Rely on build web as the compiler check. Clean up any temp files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: build web writes build\web (generated, not committed). No code-generation/snapshots to regenerate. null otherwise.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Do NOT run flutter analyze (crashes on Hebrew path). smart_relocate does NOT rewrite Dart relative imports here; if files move, fix imports manually and confirm with build web. Work only inside the worktree at .worktrees/review-improvements on branch feature/review-improvements; commit locally; do NOT push or merge. Use git -C "c:\Users\USER\OneDrive\מסמכים\Math Adventure\.worktrees\review-improvements" for git.
contribution_requirements: Steering in .kiro/steering (tech.md, structure.md, coding-conventions.md, product.md). Per-game progress (level stars, fastest times) lives in each game's own ChangeNotifier under lib/games/<game>/services/*_state.dart with namespaced shared_preferences keys. Shared systems (coins, avatar, achievements, daily streak, pet, missions) live ONLY in lib/core/services/player_profile.dart; games report round end via profile.onRoundFinished(correct, coinsEarned, threeStars, bossBeaten). Reusable UI goes in lib/core/widgets. const constructors; comic style via AppTheme (thick ink borders, AppTheme.comicShadow). Use LayoutBuilder/constraints.maxWidth, never MediaQuery.size (app is capped to 430px). Extension methods need their defining file imported. Keep SoundBridge.enabled synced on load/toggle/reset. Friendly/non-scary for ages 6-9.
key_patterns: Each sibling state is a ChangeNotifier with: SharedPreferences? _prefs; bool _loaded; bool _soundOn; Map<String,int> _levelStars; Map<String,int> _levelFastest; getters stars(id)/totalStars/fastestSeconds(id)/overallFastest/hasFastest/isLoaded/soundOn; isLevelUnlocked(level) = previous level in allLevels has >=1 star (first always unlocked); load() reads <prefix>_sound + per-level <prefix>_level_<id>/<prefix>_fastest_<id> and sets SoundBridge.enabled; setSoundOn; reset(); completeLevel(...) computes percent->stars (90/70/50), keeps best stars, records fastest only on 3-star+improved runs, awards coins via profile.addCoins, grants shared achievements via profile.grantAll, and calls profile.onRoundFinished. Each game has its own *Outcome class returned from completeLevel. Result screens are StatefulWidget with initState sound + a ComicPanel of reward rows + a _banner helper; all receive widget.profile and widget.outcome. Gameplay nav: Hub -> GameHome -> Map -> GameScreen pushReplacement-> Result; Navigator.pop() from result returns to the map (do NOT popUntil isFirst).

directory_structure: lib/main.dart boots BrainBuddiesApp. lib/app/: hub shell (brain_buddies_app.dart 430px cap, game_hub_screen.dart, shop/achievements/missions/pet/avatar screens). lib/core/: models/ (game_catalog, avatar, achievement, mission, pet), services/ (player_profile, analytics_service, feedback_service, feedback_email, sound_bridge/_stub/_web), theme/app_theme.dart, widgets/. lib/games/<game>/: self-contained models/, services/<game>_state.dart, screens/ (home=world select, map/trail, game, result), widgets/. test/ holds flutter_test files. web/index.html synthesizes SFX in JS (Web Audio) called via sound_bridge.
